title: Can I BEAT Chess960? (Freestyle Chess)
summary: Chess960 / Freestyle chess on chess.com: back-rank pieces scrambled into one of 960 positions (mirrored for both sides). Game 1 ends instantly (opponent abandons), so he plays on and wins three games by applying opening principles; castling still exists.
rules: Back-rank pieces randomly shuffled (bishops on opposite colours, king between rooks), mirrored for Black; pawns normal.
Castling is allowed (960 castling: king and rook end on the usual g/f or c/d squares).
setup: Random Chess960 position, e.g. thumbnail shows Q B R K B N R N on rank 1.
current_impl_issues: Current explain says 'there is no castling' - wrong; Chess960 castling exists and he mentions it at 0:36.

current_impl.explain: The back rank is shuffled at random and there is no castling. Checkmate the bot to win.

evidence: 0:01 rules; 0:36 'there is still castling even though it's a little bit weird'; thumbnail QBRKBNRN back rank.
